Test Scenario: Verify Policy list page loads with correct heading and subtitle
Pre-Requisites: User logged in as Operations Manager
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy
Expected result: Page title is "Policies"; heading "Policy" and subtitle "Manage policy records with complete member, agent, and financial information" are displayed

Test Scenario: Verify Total Policies and Active Policies summary cards display correct counts
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Observe summary cards
Expected result: Total Policies card shows total count with "Across all carriers"; "Active Policies" card shows active count with "{pct}% of total"; both populated from server response

Test Scenario: Verify policy data grid displays all required columns
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Observe grid headers
Expected result: Grid columns: Policy Information, Member, Agent, Carrier & Product, Status, Actions; footer shows "Showing all 100 records" or paged count

Test Scenario: Verify policy grid rows show policy number, effective date, member, agent with level and code, carrier, product and status badge
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Observe first row
Expected result: Each row shows Policy No + "Effective: MM/DD/YYYY", member name, agent name + "{level} • {code}", carrier + product, and a Status badge (Active/Lapsed/Cancelled/Expired)

Test Scenario: Verify search filters policies by policy number
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Type a known policy number in search box; 3. Wait for debounce (400ms)
Expected result: Grid refreshes and shows only the matching policy; non-matching rows removed; results update as you type

Test Scenario: Verify search filters policies by member name
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Type member name text in search box; 3. Wait for debounce
Expected result: Grid shows only policies whose member name contains the search text

Test Scenario: Verify search filters policies by agent or carrier
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Type agent name or carrier name in search box
Expected result: Grid shows only policies matching the agent or carrier text

Test Scenario: Verify search with no matching results shows empty state
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Type a random non-existent string in search box
Expected result: Grid shows "No Records Found"; record count footer shows 0 records

Test Scenario: Verify Status filter narrows the grid to selected status
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Open Status filter; 3. Select "Active"
Expected result: Every visible row's status badge is "Active"; filter option list = All Status, Active, Lapsed, Cancelled, Expired

Test Scenario: Verify Line of Business filter narrows the grid to selected LOB
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Open LOB filter; 3. Select "ACA"
Expected result: Every visible row's product line of business is ACA; options include All, ACA, Employer Group, Health, Life, Senior Products

Test Scenario: Verify Carrier filter narrows the grid to selected carrier
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Open Carrier filter; 3. Select "Aetna"
Expected result: Every visible row's carrier is Aetna; carrier options sorted alphabetically

Test Scenario: Verify combining Status and Carrier filters returns intersection
Pre-Requisites: Policies with mixed statuses across carriers
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Select Status = Active; 3. Select Carrier = Aetna
Expected result: Grid shows only Active policies for Aetna carrier (intersection of both filters)

Test Scenario: Verify Columns toggle can hide and restore grid columns
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Click Columns toggle; 3. Uncheck e.g. Member; 4. Recheck Member
Expected result: Member column hides after uncheck and reappears after recheck; other columns unaffected

Test Scenario: Verify Export grid data to Excel downloads a file
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Click Export grid data to Excel
Expected result: Exports an Excel file (filename "policies") with policy data; download triggered

Test Scenario: Verify Refresh grid data reloads the grid
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Click Refresh grid data
Expected result: Grid data reloads from server without page navigation; loading indicator appears then data renders

Test Scenario: Verify clicking a policy row navigates to the Edit Policy page
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Click a policy row (not actions cell)
Expected result: Navigates to /policy/edit/{uuid}; Edit Policy page loads with the selected policy

Test Scenario: Verify Actions kebab menu offers Edit and View Ledger
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Open Actions kebab for a policy
Expected result: Menu shows "Edit" and "View Ledger"; Edit navigates to /policy/edit/{uuid}; View Ledger navigates to /policy/ledger/{uuid}

Test Scenario: Verify Add Policy button navigates to Create Policy page
Pre-Requisites: User logged in with write access
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy; 2. Click "Add Policy"
Expected result: Navigates to /policy/create; heading "Add Policy" with subtitle "Create a new policy record."

Test Scenario: Verify Save button is disabled until all required fields are valid on Create Policy
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy/create; 2. Observe Save button with empty form
Expected result: Save button is disabled while required fields (Policy No, Enrollment Type, Product, agents, First/Last Name, Effective Date, Status) are missing

Test Scenario: Verify required field validation messages for empty Create Policy form
Steps: 1. Try to save with empty required fields
Expected result: Validation errors shown per missing field e.g. "Carrier agent is required", "Product name is required", first/last name and effective date messages; Save remains blocked

Test Scenario: Verify First Name validation rejects non-alphabetic characters
Steps: 1. Enter "John123" as First Name; 2. Submit
Expected result: Error shown: "Name must contain only alphabets and spaces"; save blocked

Test Scenario: Verify Phone No validation requires exactly 10 digits
Steps: 1. Enter "12345" as Phone No; 2. Submit
Expected result: Phone field masks input (e.g. "(123) 45"); error "Phone number must be exactly 10 digits"

Test Scenario: Verify Zip Code validation requires 5 or 9 digits
Steps: 1. Enter "12" as Zip Code; 2. Submit
Expected result: Error shown: "ZIP code must be 5 or 9 digits"; valid 5 or 9 digit zip accepted

Test Scenario: Verify date fields accept only MM/DD/YYYY format
Steps: 1. Enter "2025-13-40" or invalid text in Effective Date field; 2. Submit
Expected result: Error shown: "Invalid date format (MM/DD/YYYY)"

Test Scenario: Verify Enrollment Type dropdown lists all four options
Steps: 1. Open Enrollment Type dropdown
Expected result: Options: Not Applicable, New to Medicare, Not New to Medicare, New to Advantage with Drug Plan; default is Not Applicable

Test Scenario: Verify Policy Status dropdown lists statuses and Termination Date becomes required for non-active statuses
Steps: 1. Open Policy Status dropdown; 2. Select Lapsed/Cancelled/Expired
Expected result: Status options: Active, Lapsed, Cancelled, Expired; when Lapsed/Cancelled/Expired selected, Termination Date required - error "Termination Date is required" if empty

Test Scenario: Verify Premium Amount is optional
Steps: 1. Leave Premium Amount empty while filling all other required fields; 2. Submit
Expected result: Policy can be saved without a premium amount (no required-field error)

Test Scenario: Verify selecting a Product auto-fills Carrier, Product Type and Line of Business (read-only)
Steps: 1. Open Product Name dropdown; 2. Select a product
Expected result: Carrier Name, Product Type and Line of Business fields auto-populate and are disabled/read-only

Test Scenario: Verify agent dropdowns are searchable and show "code - name" options
Steps: 1. Open Carrier Agent dropdown; 2. Type "90058"; 3. Select "90058 - TestAgent0058 TestAgent0058"
Expected result: Agent dropdown lists "code - name" options; search narrows list; selection populates the field; same for Writing Agent and Pay to Agent

Test Scenario: Verify Member Type dropdown lists Individual, Group and Worksite
Steps: 1. Open Member Type dropdown
Expected result: Options: Individual, Group, Worksite; default Individual

Test Scenario: Verify State dropdown lists US states
Steps: 1. Open State dropdown
Expected result: State options include all 50 US states (e.g. IL - Illinois, TX - Texas); searchable

Test Scenario: Verify duplicate policy number is rejected for the same carrier
Pre-Requisites: Existing policy number on same carrier
Steps: 1. Create policy; 2. Use an existing policy number for an existing carrier; 3. Submit
Expected result: Server rejects with "This policy number already exists for this carrier. Please enter a valid policy number." mapped to Policy No field

Test Scenario: Verify Commission Structure tab is guarded until the policy is saved
Steps: 1. Click "Commission Structure" tab without saving
Expected result: Toast shown: "Please save the policy to proceed accessing commission structure."; tab does not open

Test Scenario: Verify create policy happy path with valid data
Pre-Requisites: Valid test agent and product available
Steps: 1. Fill all required fields with valid unique data; 2. Click Save; 3. Observe result
Expected result: Policy saved successfully; success toast shown; redirected back to /policy list; new policy appears (policy number unique per carrier - use new Customer UID/policy no)

Test Scenario: Verify Edit Policy page opens prefilled with existing data
Steps: 1. Navigate to /policy/edit/{uuid} via list row click
Expected result: Header shows policy number + "Carrier: {carrier}" + status chip; General tab prefills Policy No, dates, premium, member, address, product data

Test Scenario: Verify Product and Agent fields are disabled in Edit mode
Steps: 1. Open Edit Policy for a policy
Expected result: Product Name, Carrier Agent, Writing Agent and Pay to Agent fields are disabled/read-only; member and policy info fields remain editable

Test Scenario: Verify editing policy status to Lapsed/Cancelled/Expired enforces Termination Date
Steps: 1. Open Edit Policy; 2. Change status to Cancelled; 3. Leave Termination Date empty; 4. Save
Expected result: Validation error "Termination Date is required"; save blocked until termination date entered

Test Scenario: Verify Cancel with unsaved changes on Edit Policy discards via confirmation
Pre-Requisites: Policy exists, user has modified a field
Steps: 1. Open Edit Policy; 2. Modify a field; 3. Click Cancel
Expected result: Unsaved-changes confirmation (beforeunload) appears; confirming navigates back to /policy without saving; cancelling keeps editing

Test Scenario: Verify back navigation returns to policy list
Steps: 1. Open Edit Policy; 2. Click back button
Expected result: Returns to /policy list; selected policy still visible in grid

Test Scenario: Verify Commission Structure tab renders existing rule cards in Edit mode
Steps: 1. Open Edit Policy; 2. Click Commission Structure tab
Expected result: Existing commission rule cards shown with caption "{V1} | {M1-No limit} | {value}" e.g. "Commission V1 | M1-No limit | 10%"; rule configuration and split hierarchy populated

Test Scenario: Verify Add Commission Type drawer opens and allows adding a commission rule
Steps: 1. Open Commission Structure; 2. Click Add Commission Type; 3. Select type and rule; 4. Add
Expected result: Drawer opens (testid add-commission-type-drawer) with type/version/rule selection; adding a rule creates a new commission card

Test Scenario: Verify Commission rule config: payout method and payment frequency options
Steps: 1. Open a commission rule config; 2. Open Payout Method; 3. Open Payment Frequency
Expected result: Payout Method options: PERCENTAGE / Fixed Fee; Payment Frequency options: Monthly, Quarterly, Half Yearly, Annual; Month From/Month To editable (blank Month To = ongoing)

Test Scenario: Verify Calculated Commission Amount equals Premium x Percentage
Steps: 1. Set Premium Amount 18000; 2. Set Payout Method PERCENTAGE; 3. Set Percentage 10; 4. Observe Calculated Commission Amount
Expected result: Calculated Commission Amount = $1,800.00 (Premium x percentage, read-only)

Test Scenario: Verify Commission Split Hierarchy rows total 100% and show dollar split
Steps: 1. Open Commission Split Hierarchy; 2. Set Agency 5, Sales Leader 20, Agent 75; 3. Observe Total
Expected result: Rows for Agency / Sales Leader / Agent / Sub Agent; percentage column sums to Total: 100.00% = Expected: 100.00%; dollar amounts = share x commission pool (e.g. $90 / $360 / $1,350 on $1,800)

Test Scenario: Verify Preview Ledger opens and shows projected payment schedule
Steps: 1. Open Commission Structure; 2. Click Preview Ledger
Expected result: Modal (testid commission-ledger-preview) opens showing table of Month / Commission Type / Frequency / Amount / Status (Receivable/Paid/Pending badges)

Test Scenario: Verify Save Commissions persists commission structure
Steps: 1. Edit commission split percentages; 2. Click Save Commissions; 3. Reopen policy
Expected result: Commissions saved via POST/PUT /policy/commission; rules persist after reopening; Save button enabled only when valid

Test Scenario: Verify Application Date must be before Effective Date (backend rule)
Steps: 1. Set Application Date after Effective Date; 2. Submit
Expected result: Server rejects: "The application date must be before the effective date." mapped to application date field

Test Scenario: Verify DOB cannot be in the future (backend rule)
Steps: 1. Set Date of Birth to a future date; 2. Submit
Expected result: Server rejects: "Please provide a valid date of birth. The date cannot be in the future." mapped to DOB field

Test Scenario: Verify member state must be covered by the selected product (backend rule)
Steps: 1. Set member State to a state not covered by selected product; 2. Submit
Expected result: Server rejects with product state coverage error ("Product does not provide coverage for member state '{state}'.")

Test Scenario: Verify policy list search field placeholder and helper text
Steps: 1. Observe search box
Expected result: Placeholder "Search policies by number, member, agent or carrier..." and helper text "Use this search box to filter the data grid. Results will update as you type." displayed

Test Scenario: Verify commission split Total less than Expected 100 blocks save
Pre-Requisites: Valid policy saved; Commission Structure tab open
Steps: 1. Open Commission Structure; 2. Add split rule with percentage totaling <100; 3. Observe Total vs Expected; 4. Try Save
Expected result: Split Total shows the summed percentage, Expected shows 100.000 %; Save is blocked while Total != Expected

Test Scenario: Verify commission split above 100 shows exceed message and blocks save
Pre-Requisites: Valid policy saved; Commission Split Hierarchy editable
Steps: 1. Open Commission Split Hierarchy; 2. Alter split inputs so total exceeds 100%; 3. Observe error; 4. Try Save
Expected result: Error message shown: "These splits cannot add up to more than 100%. Reduce another split or enter a smaller value."; save/update blocked until total is corrected

Test Scenario: Verify Month From after Month To shows validation error
Pre-Requisites: Valid policy saved; Commission Structure tab open
Steps: 1. Add commission rule; 2. Set From Month later than To Month; 3. Save rule
Expected result: Inline error shown: "To month should be greater than or equal to From month"; rule not saved

Test Scenario: Verify commission rule with empty rule name is rejected
Pre-Requisites: Valid policy saved; Commission Structure tab open
Steps: 1. Add commission rule; 2. Leave Name empty; 3. Try to save rule
Expected result: Error shown for empty rule name; rule cannot be saved without a name

Test Scenario: Verify duplicate commission rule cannot be added
Pre-Requisites: Policy with an existing commission rule
Steps: 1. Add a second rule identical in type/month to an existing one; 2. Save
Expected result: Duplicate rule is rejected with an error; only one rule allowed for the same configuration

Test Scenario: Verify commission percentage above maximum limit is rejected
Pre-Requisites: Valid policy saved; Commission Structure tab open
Steps: 1. Enter a percentage exceeding the allowed max (e.g. 1000); 2. Try to save rule
Expected result: Server/UI rejects the percentage as invalid (max 999); error surfaced on the percentage field

Test Scenario: Verify FMV product with Percentage payout forces Fixed Fee
Pre-Requisites: Policy with FMV product; Commission Structure tab open
Steps: 1. Add a commission rule; 2. Attempt to use Percentage/Percentage of MF payout; 3. Observe Payout Type
Expected result: For FMV products the app forces/shows a warning to use Fixed Fee payout; Percentage payout not applied

Test Scenario: Verify sub-agent split without reporting manager shows hierarchy error
Pre-Requisites: Valid policy; sub-agent selected in split hierarchy
Steps: 1. Add a split with a sub-agent; 2. Leave reporting hierarchy incomplete; 3. Try Save
Expected result: Hierarchy/relationship error toast surfaced (reporting agent missing/invalid); split not saved

Test Scenario: Verify Dependents history To date before From date is rejected
Steps: 1. In Dependents History set To earlier than From; 2. Save
Expected result: Inline error "To should be greater than or equal to From"; entry rejected

Test Scenario: Verify Dependents history entry without From or To date is rejected
Steps: 1. Add dependents history row leaving From blank; 2. Try to save
Expected result: Inline error "From should be a valid date" (analogous for blank To); row not accepted

Test Scenario: Verify Dependents No accepts only a valid positive number
Steps: 1. Enter 0 or leave Dependents No blank; 2. Try to save
Expected result: Error "No. of dependents should be valid number"; save blocked

Test Scenario: Verify Termination Date before Effective Date is rejected
Pre-Requisites: Policy with saved data; status active
Steps: 1. Edit policy; 2. Set Termination Date before Effective Date; 3. Save
Expected result: Backend validation error; termination must be after the effective date; save blocked

Test Scenario: Verify Application Date equal to Effective Date is rejected
Steps: 1. Create policy; 2. Set Application Date same as Effective Date; 3. Try save
Expected result: Backend rule rejects: application date must be strictly before the effective date

Test Scenario: Verify policy list load failure surfaces error toast and retry
Steps: 1. Navigate to Policy list with API failing; 2. Observe page
Expected result: "Something went wrong." error toast shown; Refresh/retry re-loads the grid on recovery

Test Scenario: Verify blank Policy Number is blocked on Create
Steps: 1. Open Create Policy; 2. Leave Policy No blank; 3. Try save
Expected result: Validation error "Policy number cannot be blank"; save blocked

Test Scenario: Verify negative Premium Amount is rejected
Steps: 1. Enter a negative premium amount; 2. Try save
Expected result: Premium validation rejects negative value; save blocked with field error

Test Scenario: Verify Create Policy API failure keeps form data and shows toast
Steps: 1. Fill valid Create Policy form; 2. Trigger save failure; 3. Observe
Expected result: Error toast shown; modal/page stays with entered values intact for retry
